text:
eva-bot: Nightly eval finished for rdx-llama3-13b -> quant/int8/dynamic. Regression detected: 14/200 prompt failures (baseline 2/200). Failure mode: empty or truncated summaries on summarization-set-v3. Dashboard: <https://dash.internal/redwood/rdx-llama3/1957772468|view report>

maria: Noted. Is this the build with quant-calibrator v2? @liam did we swap calibrator yesterday?

liam: We merged calib v2 to main last night (PR #482). It changes sampling from `centroid` -> `uniform`. Could be dataset mismatch.

dan: I ran a local smoke: `./tools/nightly_eval --model rdx-llama3-13b --quant int8 --calib-method uniform --seed 17 --prompts summarization-set-v3` got 12/200 empty outputs. Logs below.

saira: Any examples of empty outputs?

dan: Yes, here's a clipped generation:
```
Input: "Summarize: The quarterly report shows growth in..."\nOutput: "\n"\nLog: generation returned length=0, kv_cache_hit=false
```
Seems like beam broke or EOS token mispredicted.

jen: Does the tokenizer mapping change with int8 export? We had an issue where BOS/EOS id shifted when using hf-export pipeline.

maria: Good point. Check the export step. The quant pipeline uses `export_to_torch --preserve-special-tokens` — maybe dropped.

liam: I bisected a bit: if I run with `--calib-samples 8192` failures drop to 3/200. With 512 they're 18/200. So sample set size is sensitive.

saira: So calibration sample count matters. Could be sample skew: the nightly calib set is shorter sequences (mean len 22) vs eval prompts (mean len 120). That hurts scale estimates.

dan: I pushed a quick experiment: swapped calibrator back to centroid sampling and kept calib-samples=2048. Nightly re-run shows 4/200 failures. PR incoming.

jen: :thumbsup: Can you log the max absolute scale per-layer? We want to see saturation.

dan: Added this snippet to the eval harness:
```
for layer in model.layers:
  stats.log(layer.name, 'scale_max', layer.quant.scale.abs().max().item())
```
Early output: some layers show scale_max ~ 8.9 which seems high.

maria: High scale suggests outliers in calib set. Let's try zap outliers with percentile trimming.

liam: Agree. Quick mitigation: apply 99.5 percentile clamp when computing scale. Re-run locally -> failures 1/200.

saira: Can someone schedule a canary nightly with clamp+centroid? If stable we'll roll for the next dedicated run.

maria: I'll open the RFC/PR with benchmark numbers and add a note to release checklist. Also add a test that runs summarization-set-v3 with quant configs.

eva-bot: Noted. Nightly alert closed (investigation in progress).
